data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue for Silver Rock
data.body:
Hi,

Silver Rock’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in OPTU, CYH, and CABO.

OPTU received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an August 14, 2026 Form 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1702780/000170278026000052/optu-20260813.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot? Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
